name: feature-flow

frames.best_why: The whole intro block plus the first feature cards read clearly, with no cursor over text.

tagline: Four feature cards slide sideways under a headline and round arrows.
summary: A white feature block with a bold sales pitch, a row of icon cards that scroll horizontally, and round arrow buttons above the cards.
appearance: A white section with a small uppercase tag, a heavy two-line headline, a grey paragraph and two thin circular arrows at the upper right. Below runs a row of four pale orange-tinted cards, each with an orange line icon, a bold title and small grey copy.
behaviour: The arrow buttons slide the card row one card at a time, leaving the next card peeking past the edge. Arrows fade when the first or last card is reached, and each card deepens its shadow on hover.
demo_content: Sales pitch 'Prospect to customer, faster than ever!' with cards like Prioritize high-values and CRM Integration.
search_phrases: card row you can scroll sideways
benefit cards under a bold heading
product features in a slider row
use_when: A feature set is too long for one row and should stay browsable with clear arrows.
avoid_when: Cards are hardcoded, so adding or renaming a feature means editing the component file.
customise: Feature titles, copy and icons come from the items array in this file; card tint and spacing are class names to edit.
weight_why: Eight small cards and one carousel transform; idle when untouched.

a11y.note: Arrow buttons carry proper labels, but there is no reduced-motion handling for the sliding row.

issues: Card copy switches product names, calling the tool Skyrocket on the first card and SkyLead later.
The cards and their text are fixed in the source, with no way to pass a different list.
polish_why: Balanced type and tinted cards; mixed product names and a clipped card show through.
title: Feature Flow Carousel
